turns.text: 喂，您好，请问是张伟吗？我是站长，通知您飞毛腿合同已经生效了。
是我，张伟。合同生效了是吧？那我今天是不是得跑够5单？

coverage_evidence.label: identity_confirmation
coverage_evidence.evidence: 站长在对话开头说“请问是张伟吗？”，明确确认骑手身份。
coverage_evidence.speaker: agent

coverage_evidence.label: contract_effective_notification
coverage_evidence.evidence: 站长说“通知您飞毛腿合同已经生效了”，明确告知合同已生效。
coverage_evidence.speaker: agent

coverage_evidence.label: delivery_willingness_confirmation
coverage_evidence.evidence: 站长未询问骑手是否愿意或能够开始配送，仅通知合同生效。
coverage_evidence.speaker: agent

coverage_evidence.label: minimum_order_requirement
coverage_evidence.evidence: 站长未提及任何最低单量数字或合同类型对应关系。
coverage_evidence.speaker: agent

coverage_evidence.label: continuous_delivery_requirement
coverage_evidence.evidence: 站长未提及连续配送天数要求。
coverage_evidence.speaker: agent

coverage_evidence.label: expression_natural_short
coverage_evidence.evidence: 站长回复约30字，语气自然口语化，像打电话。
coverage_evidence.speaker: agent
